recipe.title: Fried Egg
recipe: Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat.
Crack in the egg and fry until the white sets.
Serve the fried egg.

recipe.title: Pasta with Tomato Sauce
recipe: Boil the pasta in water until tender, then drain.
Separately simmer the tomatoes with olive oil to make a sauce.
Toss the drained pasta with the sauce and serve.

recipe.title: Vanilla Cake
recipe: Whisk flour, milk, and eggs into a batter.
Pour the batter into a pan and bake at 350°F for 30 minutes.
Cool the cake and serve.

recipe.title: Simple Bread
recipe: Mix flour, water, and yeast into dough.
Knead the dough, then let it rise for 1 hour.
Bake the risen dough at 400°F for 30 minutes.

recipe.title: Chicken Stir Fry
recipe: Cook the chicken in half the oil until browned; set it aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli in the remaining oil.
Return the chicken to the pan and toss with the broccoli.

recipe.title: Marinated Chicken
recipe: Mix soy sauce and lemon juice into a marinade.
Coat the chicken with the marinade and chill for 30 minutes.
Roast the marinated chicken at 400°F until cooked through.

recipe.title: Garlic Rice
recipe: Toast rice in half the butter.
Cook the rice with water until tender.
Cook garlic in the remaining butter, then fold it into the rice.

recipe.title: Berry Yogurt
recipe: Spoon yogurt into a bowl.
Toss berries with honey separately.
Top the yogurt with the sweetened berries and serve.

recipe.title: Glazed Tofu
recipe: Whisk soy sauce and honey into a glaze. Reserve half.
Toss the tofu with the remaining glaze and fry until crisp.
Drizzle the reserved glaze over the tofu and serve.

recipe.title: Ambiguous Vegetables
recipe: Chop the onion and carrot separately.
Set one aside and cook the other until soft.
Combine them and serve.
